topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Hey, I just heard about the fence. I don't know, it feels like things are changing, you know? Ever since we moved in, it’s been so open, just this easy flow between our yards. The kids run back and forth without a care, and sometimes I think our dogs even chat when we're not looking. A fence... it seems like it would be a bit of a barrier, you know? It’s not that I mind privacy or anything, but it’s the idea of closing off this space that feels like such a part of our home now. I hope we can still catch up over the fence, maybe even have a few more barbecues. Just the same neighbors we’ve always been.
